title: INTELLIGENT CORPUS REMIXER -- slice a sound, map it by timbre, play it by clicking

sections.heading: USING IT
lines: Drop an audio file on the drop area, or click read to choose one.
The file is sliced at its onsets, analysed and clustered by itself; slices shows the count.
The plotter shows every slice as a dot, placed by timbre and coloured by cluster.
Click or drag in the plotter to play the nearest slice.
K clusters: how many timbre groups to find. Click re-cluster to apply a new K.
loop: slices repeat seamlessly while on; turn it off and running loops finish.
random: plays random slices from the chosen cluster every rate (ms).
randomize pan: each slice gets a random stereo position instead of centre.
Use audio on/off to start sound and the gain fader to set the level (meters beside it).

sections.heading: HOW IT WORKS
lines: Needs the FluCoMa package. fluid.bufonsetslice~ finds onsets; tiny slices merge into neighbours.
Each slice gets a 13-band MFCC average, normalised, then mapped to 2D with fluid.umap~.
fluid.kmeans~ groups slices into K clusters; a kd-tree finds the slice nearest your click.
poly~ slice-voice (8 voices) plays slices from one shared buffer with 5 ms fades.
